description.value: Bodega Ridge is a 22-acre resort on the wild north end of Galiano Island, built around a collection of rustic log cabins, The Pink Geranium Café and General Store, and the restaurant Lola (currently temporarily closed). Originally a horse ranch from 1980, the property has been reimagined as a destination for rest, retreats, and weddings amid arbutus trees with views of the Salish Sea. Cyclists passing through Galiano Island can stop at The Pink Geranium to refuel before continuing their island exploration.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bodega Ridge is a Galiano Island resort at 120 Manastee Rd with phone (250) 539-2677, not in Chemainus as OSM's community field suggests — a geographic mismatch. The Lola restaurant page explicitly states 'Temporarily closed – New location coming soon,' though The Pink Geranium Café and General Store appear to remain operational as part of the resort complex. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information is mentioned anywhere on the site.

The Lola restaurant (the primary sit-down dining component) is explicitly listed as 'Temporarily closed – New location coming soon' on the website; The Pink Geranium Café appears to remain open.
